ex.en: My classmate lent me a pencil before the lesson.
ex.zh: 上课前，我的同班同学借给我一支铅笔。

ex.en: Working with classmates on group projects can help students develop communication and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 与同班同学合作完成小组项目可以帮助学生培养沟通和解决问题的能力。

col: a former classmate｜以前的同班同学
help a classmate｜帮助同班同学
tip: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。

senses.en: a short piece of music with words that people sing

ex.en: Our music teacher teaches us a cheerful new English song today.
ex.zh: 我们的音乐老师今天教我们一首欢快的新英文歌。

ex.en: At the school concert, the choir sang a beautiful song about friendship and dreams.
ex.zh: 在学校音乐会上，合唱团唱了一首关于友谊和梦想的优美歌曲。

col: a popular song｜一首流行歌曲
tip: song是可数名词，“唱一首歌”常用sing a song，注意与sing区分。

senses.en: a public building where visitors learn about science through fun displays

ex.en: We saw a cool talking robot at the science museum yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在科技馆看到了一个酷酷的会说话的机器人。

ex.en: Our class visited the Shenzhen science museum to watch exciting space and physics shows.
ex.zh: 我们班参观了深圳科技馆，观看了精彩的太空和物理展示。

col: visit the science museum｜参观科技馆
in the science museum｜在科技馆里
tip: science中的sc发/s/音，不要漏掉字母c；两个词中间要空格。
